audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo takes six of seven stages in a matchup the packet puts at 57.24% for Sejuani over 152 games, and MC_WR_TABLES on disk puts at 46.15% over 325 games. The two sources disagree about who is even favoured.
audit.why: I cannot pick a chart without knowing which win rate is the live one, and the mirror audit at audits/top/teemo__sejuani.json hit the same wall and flagged it rather than editing. Changing my side alone would break a currently-agreeing mirror.
audit.corrected: Left unchanged; raised in questionsForUser with both figures named.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid states Blinding Dart is 'roughly 10 seconds at rank 1', and the level-6 spike says Glacial Prison outranges it without a number.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter and it is never rank-gated, so a player counting to 10 walks into it. Glacial Prison is 1300 against Blinding Dart's 680 range, which is the real size of the level-6 spike.
audit.corrected: 7 seconds flat written into mid; 1300 against 680 written into whys[4] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields say Blinding Dart blanks Sejuani's W auto-resets and shuts down every trade she attempts.
audit.why: Winter's Wrath is not an auto-reset — it is a spell that swings her mace twice, and it is the ability that applies Frost stacks. A blind stops basic attacks only, so Blinding Dart cannot stop the W arcs, cannot stop Frost from capping, and cannot stop Permafrost. The old text tells the player their entire combo is disabled when it is not, which turns a winnable level-3 punish into a permanent concede. The mirror audit found the same thing from Teemo's side.
audit.corrected: Restated everywhere: the blind takes your autos, never Winter's Wrath, so the Frost chain still arms through it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor's slow immunity against his shroom slows was never mentioned.
audit.why: Fury of the North grants immunity to slows while Frost Armor is up, so a mushroom damages your approach but does not stop it as long as you are out of combat when you step on it.
audit.corrected: Written into late alongside the sweeper advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: No note that Toxic Shot is on-hit damage scaling with attack speed.
audit.why: Armour alone reads his damage wrong — his throughput rises with attack speed and his poison is magic damage, so magic resist and health matter more than a second armour item.

edits.after: Levels 1-2 are Teemo's best window and your worst — but not for the reason it feels like. Blinding Dart takes your basic attacks, never Winter's Wrath, so Frost still stacks through it; what actually beats you here is his range and his poison ticking on every step into auto range. Take W first, last-hit at the edge of your W range, and let Doran's Shield and Second Wind eat the poke. Do not burn your Q on a blind engage — Arctic Assault is your only escape and spending it on a losing trade strands you for his jungler. At level 3 your full Q-into-W-W-into-E chain comes online: if he steps past the wave line, that is your punish — Q onto him, both W strikes for Frost, then Permafrost before he kites back.
edits.before: Levels 1-2 are Teemo's best window and your worst — he has no ability to return your CC, but Blinding Dart completely blanks your W auto-resets and his poison ticks punish every step into auto range. Take W first, last-hit at the edge of your W range, and accept the free poke while Doran's Shield and Second Wind eat it. Do not burn your Q on a blind engage — Arctic Assault is your only escape and burning it for a trade you cannot win strands you for a Teemo counter-chase or his jungler. At level 3 your full Q-into-W-W-into-E chain comes online: if he ever steps past the wave line with Blinding Dart down, that is your punish window — Q onto him, land both W strikes for Frost stacks, then E stun before he can kite back into safety.

edits.after: Level 6 is your actual lane transformation. Glacial Prison launches at 1300 against the 680 Teemo needs for Blinding Dart — you can throw R through a wall gap or from river and stun him before he reacts, negating the one tool that makes him feel unapproachable. After R connects, walk up, W twice for full Frost, and Permafrost extends the chain into a near-certain kill. Between level 6 and your first item, every time your jungler is nearby the lane is an execution: Teemo has no dash and no hard CC to interrupt your approach once R is in flight. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so count seven and commit.
edits.before: Level 6 is your actual lane transformation. Between level 6 and your first item, every time Blinding Dart is on cooldown and your jungler is nearby, the lane is a guaranteed execution — Teemo has no dash and no hard CC to interrupt your approach once R is in flight. Track his Q cooldown (roughly 10 seconds at rank 1) and commit only in that gap.

edits.after: By 2+ items you are essentially unkillable by Teemo's poke, and your Permafrost chain covers enough area to lock him through any directional kite. The threat shifts entirely to vision: his Noxious Traps wall off brushes and jungle corridors, so sweep every objective zone before Baron or Dragon — though Frost Armor makes you immune to slows, so a shroom hurts your approach without stopping it. Build magic resist and health rather than a second armour item: Toxic Shot is on-hit magic damage that scales with his attack speed. In a fight, Q past his frontline, R the backline, and Permafrost anything disengaging.
edits.before: By 2+ items you are essentially unkillable by Teemo's poke damage, and your Permafrost stun chain covers enough area to lock him through any directional kite. The threat shifts entirely to vision: his Noxious Traps wall off brushes and jungle corridors, so sweep every objective zone with a Sweeper before Baron or Dragon and mark his shroom placement patterns on your team. In a straight teamfight you are his worst nightmare — Q-charge past his frontline, R the backline, Permafrost anything that tries to disengage, and your passive resistances make the poison ticks irrelevant. Close the game through objectives rather than chasing a splitpushing Teemo through a minefield.
